fixordium.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for Fixordium. Enables early rendering optimizations and allows Fixordium's other optimizations to apply.
fixordium.option.decoration_culling.tool: Applies Fixordium's early off-screen culling to item frames, glow item frames, and armor stands.
fixordium.option.entity_shadows.tooltip: Renders entity shadows. Disable this to skip entity shadow rendering. Smart Mode may temporarily disable shadows when FPS is below the target.
fixordium.option.debug_counter.tooltip: Shows live skipped-render statistics and Smart Mode status in the top-right corner.
fixordium.option.smart_mode.tooltip: Monitors gameplay FPS. When FPS falls below the target, Fixordium temporarily disables entity shadows and animated block-entity visuals, then restores them after performance recovers.
fixordium.option.smart_target_fps.toolti: The FPS target used by Smart Mode. Fixordium uses hysteresis so visual settings do not rapidly switch on and off.
fixordium.option.container_animations.to: Controls smooth Chest, Ender Chest and Shulker Box animations. When disabled, they snap between open and closed states. Barrels already use an instant open/closed state in vanilla.
fixordium.option.block_entity_animations: Controls continuous animations for banners, bells, enchanting-table books, skulls, spawners, beacons, conduits, vaults and End Gateway beams. Disable to keep them visually static.
fixordium.option.stop_music_on_pause.too: Stops the currently playing Minecraft music when the pause menu is opened with Escape. This can remove a small amount of audio streaming/decoding work while paused; the same track does not resume automatically.
